from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "Orbits: The Path of a Point"
        lecture_lines = [
            "An orbit is the sequence of points generated.",
            "Some points spiral inward toward a stable attractor.",
            "Others escape, shooting off to infinity very quickly.",
            "Some may wander forever in a repeating cycle.",
            "Every point follows a unique path through the plane."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # Define colors
        c_formula = WHITE
        c_stable = "#00FF00"
        c_escape = "#FF4500"
        c_cycle = "#00FF00"
        c_final = WHITE

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(c_formula)
        # Show the formula z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c
        formula = MathTex(r"z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c", color=c_formula)
        self.place_in_area(formula, "A2", "A5", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        
        # Plane setup
        plane = ComplexPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=3,
            y_length=3,
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.3}
        )
        self.place_in_area(plane, "B2", "E5", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Create(plane))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(c_stable)
        
        # P1 at (0.1, 0.1) - make it visible with a decent dot size
        p1_coord = complex(0.1, 0.1)
        p1 = Dot(plane.n2p(p1_coord), color=c_stable, radius=0.08)
        p1_label = Text("P1", font_size=16, color=c_stable).add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(p1, UR, buff=0.1))
        
        # Spiral path for P1 (symbolic of spiraling inward)
        # To make it visible, we start slightly further but keep the logic
        spiral_points = [plane.n2p(p1_coord * (0.8**t) * np.exp(1j * t * 0.5)) for t in np.linspace(0, 10, 40)]
        spiral_path = VMobject().set_points_as_corners(spiral_points)
        
        trail_p1 = TracedPath(p1.get_center, stroke_color=c_stable, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(p1), Write(p1_label))
        self.add(trail_p1)
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(p1, spiral_path), run_time=3)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(c_escape)
        
        # P2 at (1.5, 1.5)
        p2_coord = complex(1.5, 1.5)
        p2 = Dot(plane.n2p(p2_coord), color=c_escape, radius=0.08)
        p2_label = Text("P2", font_size=16, color=c_escape).add_updater(lambda m: m.next_to(p2, UR, buff=0.1))
        
        trail_p2 = TracedPath(p2.get_center, stroke_color=c_escape, stroke_width=2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(p2), Write(p2_label))
        self.add(trail_p2)
        
        # Shoot off-screen
        # Calculate target relative to plane center
        off_screen_point = p2.get_center() + RIGHT * 4 + UP * 3
        self.play(p2.animate.move_to(off_screen_point), run_time=1.5, rate_func=rush_into)
        p2_label.clear_updaters()
        self.play(FadeOut(p2_label))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(c_cycle)
        
        # Glow around P1's final position (origin)
        glow_circle = Circle(radius=0.4, color=c_cycle)
        glow_circle.move_to(plane.n2p(0))
        glow_circle.set_fill(c_cycle, opacity=0.3)
        glow_circle.set_stroke(c_cycle, width=2)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(glow_circle))
        self.play(Indicate(glow_circle, color=c_cycle))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(c_final)
        
        # Final highlight of all elements
        self.play(
            Indicate(formula),
            Indicate(p1),
            Indicate(glow_circle)
        )
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        """
        Sets up the background, title, and bullet points on the left side.
        """
        # Set background
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        
        # Title at the top
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=32, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Bullet points container (Left side)
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"• {line}", font_size=24, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.7)
        
        # Grid initialization for right-side visuals
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]
        
        # Define 6x6 grid coordinates restricted to the right half of the screen
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # x shifts to the right side (0.5 to 5.5), y spans center (-2.5 to 2.5)
                x = 1.0 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        """
        Utility to place a mobject at a specific grid coordinate.
        """
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # Configuration for Section 3: Holomorphic Dynamics
        title_content = "Holomorphic Dynamics & Iteration"
        lecture_bullets = [
            "Complex Plane Mapping",
            "Fixed Points & Stability",
            "The Iteration z_{n+1} = f(z_n)",
            "Defining the Julia Set"
        ]

        # 1. Initialize Layout
        self.setup_layout(title_content, lecture_bullets)
        
        # Animate bullets one by one
        for bullet in self.lecture:
            self.play(FadeIn(bullet, shift=RIGHT), run_time=0.6)

        # 2. Visual Representation: Complex Mapping
        # Creating a small coordinate system on the right grid
        plane_center = self.grid["C3"]
        plane = ComplexPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=3,
            y_length=3,
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.4}
        ).move_to(plane_center)

        # Function label
        func_label = MathTex("f(z) = z^2 + c", font_size=30, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(func_label, "A3")

        self.play(
            Create(plane),
            Write(func_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        # 3. Iteration Visualization
        # Example points: mapping z_0 -> z_1 -> z_2
        z0_val = 0.5 + 0.2j
        c_val = -0.4 + 0.3j
        
        z0_point = plane.n2p(z0_val)
        dot0 = Dot(z0_point, color=BLUE, radius=0.08)
        lbl0 = MathTex("z_0", font_size=20).next_to(dot0, UR, buff=0.05)

        self.play(FadeIn(dot0), Write(lbl0))

        # Iteration 1
        z1_val = z0_val**2 + c_val
        z1_point = plane.n2p(z1_val)
        dot1 = Dot(z1_point, color=RED, radius=0.08)
        arrow1 = Arrow(dot0.get_center(), dot1.get_center(), buff=0.1, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow1), FadeIn(dot1))

        # 4. Symbolic Logic on the Grid
        chaos_text = Text("Chaotic Motion", font_size=22, color=RED)
        self.place_at_grid(chaos_text, "F3")
        
        rect = SurroundingRectangle(chaos_text, color=RED, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(
            Write(chaos_text),
            Create(rect)
        )

        # Final Wait
        self.wait(3)
